title: Ouroboros Queen
description: A surreal painting depicts a crowned woman in ornate metallic armor seated at the center of a large ouroboros serpent forming an infinity symbol. The serpent has detailed scales with embedded car and road patterns, drips yellow liquid, and is surrounded by floating money, peace signs, and ghostly background figures against a dark, smoky backdrop.
prompt: surreal symbolic painting of a regal woman wearing an ornate crown and intricate metallic armor, seated within a giant ouroboros serpent twisted into an infinity loop with detailed scales containing embedded car and road motifs, the serpent drips yellow liquid from its body, floating around are dollar bills, peace signs, and ghostly faded figures in a dark smoky background with blue purple and yellow tones, mysterious and ominous atmosphere
